gloss: vacant lot; empty plot of land

definitions.gloss: vacant lot; empty plot of land; unused land
definitions.explanation: A piece of land that has no buildings or structures on it and is not being used for any particular purpose.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたちが{空|あ}き{地|ち}で{遊|あそ}んでいる。
examples.english: Children are playing in the vacant lot.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}の{空|あ}き{地|ち}にマンションが{建|た}つらしい。
examples.english: Apparently an apartment building is going to be built on the vacant lot in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}{放置|ほうち}されていた{空|あ}き{地|ち}が{雑草|ざっそう}だらけになり、{近所|きんじょ}から{苦情|くじょう}が{出|で}ている。
examples.english: The vacant lot that had been left unattended for years became overgrown with weeds, and complaints have come from the neighborhood.

notes:
USAGE:
{空|あ}き{地|ち} is a compound of {空|あ}き (empty, vacant) and {地|ち} (land). In Japanese neighborhoods, vacant lots are often associated with childhood play and are a common setting in manga and anime.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空|あ}き{地|ち}で{遊|あそ}ぶ (to play in a vacant lot)
- {空|あ}き{地|ち}を{利用|りよう}する (to make use of a vacant lot)
- {空|あ}き{地|ち}に{駐車|ちゅうしゃ}する (to park on a vacant lot)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {空|あ}き{地|ち}: vacant lot (general, everyday)
- {更地|さらち}: cleared land, empty lot (ready for construction)
- {荒|あ}れ{地|ち}: wasteland, barren land (uncultivated, wild)
